_doc: Single source of truth for what gets compiled, surfaced to the web, and tested across the framework matrix. setup.py / CMakeLists.txt / tests/conftest.py / platform/game_service all consume this file. Schema per entry: id (str), enabled (bool, default true — disabled games skip build entirely), sources (list[str]; relative to games/<id>/, consumed verbatim by the build), capabilities (list[str]; tags consumed by the framework test matrix — see capability glossary below), framework_whitelist (bool, default false — true means the game must satisfy the core invariants the framework guards). To add a game: append an entry. To temporarily disable: set enabled=false. Display order in the web UI follows declaration order here.

_capabilities_doc.hidden_info: Game has perspective-private slots (viz != all_public). Triggers tests that verify AI cannot read truth's hidden fields.
_capabilities_doc.snapshot: Game registers public_state_applier — public state flows wire-side via PublicEventTrace.public_snapshot rather than via do_action_fast. Triggers public-snapshot round-trip tests.
_capabilities_doc.tracker: Game registers a belief_tracker factory. Triggers tracker-consistency tests.
